description: Return a betslipdoctor.ai link (linkUrl, expiresAt) the customer opens to sign in to their sportsbook and link it, the same sportsbook linking page the app opens; it works for 10 minutes. book is the sportsbook to pick on that page (e.g. FanDuel), state its two-letter state. If sportsbook linking is not yet allowed, the tool returns book_link_required with consent.text, consent.privacyUrl and consent.textVersion: show that text and the privacy link to the customer word for word. Only after their explicit yes, call again with consent true, that consentTextVersion and a commandKey; a missing or stale version is refused. Never sees sportsbook passwords and never places a wager.
name: connect_sportsbook
title: Connect a sportsbook
